info.title: Switch Frame Tap
info.author: Papux200
info.description: Stream your games to a PC at 1080p60
info.details:
Switch Frame Tap is a sysmodule that streams the game you are playing - picture and sound - to a Windows or Linux PC, with no capture card. It takes the game's frames before the system recorder and encodes them with the Switch's own H.264 encoder: native 1080p at 60 fps.

- USB cable in handheld, or the network (Wi-Fi or the dock's LAN port) to play docked
- Game audio, and recording to MP4 on the PC
- Webcam mode: the Switch shows up as a USB camera for OBS
- Native-resolution PNG screenshots on a button combo
- This manager app for the settings, plus a Tesla/Ultrahand overlay

Needs Atmosphere, and the PC viewer (Windows or Linux) from the GitHub releases page. Tested on firmware 22.5.0 with Atmosphere 1.11.2 (Mariko, and a Switch Lite). Experimental: it attaches to the running game like a debugger, so cheats won't work on a game while it streams.

changelog: 0.7.0: network streaming - play docked, with the picture quality adapting to the network. One connection at a time: USB viewer, USB webcam or network.
